parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT client_id, slug, currency, timezone
FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.ref.clients`
WHERE status='active' AND has_woocommerce=TRUE
ORDER BY client_id

=SELECT
  COALESCE(
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_SUB(MAX(date_modified_gmt), INTERVAL 2 HOUR)),
    '2025-01-01T00:00:00'
  ) AS modified_after,
  -- The backfill does not resume from what is already loaded: raw is
  -- append-only and stg dedups on the newest ingested_at, so re-reading an
  -- order is free, whereas resuming from MAX(date_created_gmt) after a
  -- modified-ordered run would skip every older order it had not reached.
  '2025-01-01T00:00:00' AS created_after
FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.raw.raw_woo_orders`
WHERE client_id = '{{ $('Decode secrets').item.json.client_id }}'
  AND order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'

=INSERT INTO `oneeighty-warehouse.ops.pipeline_log`
  (run_id, workflow, client_id, source, started_at, finished_at, status, rows_loaded, trigger)
VALUES
{{ $('Decode secrets').all().map(c => { const cid = c.json.client_id; const n = $('Transform orders').all().filter(t => t.json.client_id === cid).length; return "('" + $execution.id + "','wf_woocommerce','" + cid + "','woocommerce',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),'success'," + n + ",'" + ($execution.mode === 'manual' ? 'manual' : 'cron') + "')"; }).join(',\n') }}
